The '''hepatizon laurel''' is a head piece that never breaks and doubles the wearer's base movement speed.

== Obtaining ==
An expert-level [[Jeweler|jeweler]] sells it for 10 [[Obol|obols]] and 2 [[Hepatizon Alloy|hepatizon alloy]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/toolsmith/4/hepatizon_laurel.json}}</ref>
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==
It gives 1 armor and adds 0.1 movement speed, equal to the player's whole base speed. Like [[jewelry]], it is built on a poisonous potato that can't be eaten and doesn't stack, so it has no durability and never breaks. It burns in fire or lava when dropped, and it doesn't keep [[piglin]]s calm as adamant and electrum armor do.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/toolsmith/4/hepatizon_laurel.json}}</ref>
